description: A utility module for versioned, per-organization salted password hashing and verification, supporting multiple algorithms (Argon2id, bcrypt, scrypt) with fallback mechanisms, including legacy support and tenant-specific salt management.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the global optional pepper string from environment variables.

methods.name: buildHashInput
methods.description: Constructs the input string for hashing or verification, incorporating password, tenant orgSalt, and pepper based on version.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred scheme (Argon2id, bcrypt, or scrypt fallback), with tenant-specific salt support.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy static salt with scrypt, for verification of existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against stored hash, determining algorithm by hash format, and indicates if migration is needed.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares a constructed input with a stored hash, supporting Argon2, bcrypt, and scrypt formats.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password with specified version (default v2), supporting legacy fallback.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies password and provides migration path from legacy to current scheme if needed.
